summary: CRM Sprint 1 Testing Complete - Tags, Service Areas, Lead Map all working correctly

backend_tags.GET /api/crm/tags: PASS - Returns 8 auto-seeded default tags (VIP, Hot Lead, Referido, Corporativo, Social, Hotel, Gobierno, Recurrente)
backend_tags.POST /api/crm/tags: PASS - Creates new tag with name and color
backend_tags.DELETE /api/crm/tags/{tag_id}: PASS - Deletes tag and removes from leads

backend_service_areas.GET /api/crm/service-areas: PASS - Returns RD with 7 regions (Distrito Nacional, Santo Domingo, Santiago, La Altagracia, Puerto Plata, La Romana, Samaná)

backend_geo_stats.GET /api/crm/geo-stats: PASS - Returns city aggregation with lead counts (cities array + no_city_count)

frontend_lead_map.lead_map_section: PASS - Shows Lead Map section with bubble visualization
frontend_lead_map.city_bubbles: PASS - Shows 5 city bubbles (Santiago: 2, Santo Domingo: 1x3, Punta Cana: 1)
frontend_lead_map.bubble_hover: PASS - Hover shows tooltip with city details (Total, New, Contacted, Engaged)
frontend_lead_map.bubble_click_filter: PASS - Clicking bubble filters lead list and shows 'Clear filter' button
frontend_lead_map.clear_filter: PASS - Clear filter button removes city filter

frontend_crm_config.navigation: PASS - Settings > Automation dropdown > CRM Config
frontend_crm_config.tags_section: PASS - Shows 8 predefined tags with colored dots
frontend_crm_config.tags_crud: PASS - '+ New Tag' button available for creating tags
frontend_crm_config.service_areas_section: PASS - Shows República Dominicana with DO code and '7 regions' badge
frontend_crm_config.service_areas_expand: PASS - Clicking expands to show all 7 regions with cities
frontend_crm_config.service_areas_crud: PASS - '+ Add Country', '+ Region', '+ City' buttons available

context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Sprint 1 fully tested. Tags auto-seed 8 defaults on first GET. Service Areas auto-seed RD with 7 regions. Geo-stats aggregates leads by city for map visualization. Lead Map shows proportional bubbles with hover tooltips and click-to-filter. CRM Config tab is under Settings > Automation dropdown. Session cookies expire quickly - login fresh before each page.
